newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee, cocoa end weaker, sugar trims gains.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee, cocoa end weaker, sugar trims gains.

text.p: COFFEE - Retains early PM losses after early NY slide slowed. Ivory/Brazil crop news noted. Jan ends $19 lower at $1,430.
COCOA - Eases further on stg's strength, origin sales. Volume thin, most values lower. March ends three down at 925 stg.
SUGAR - March premium sellers cap gains from trade buying. Ranges and volume thin. Unchanged at $303.90 at 1704 GMT.
